hero.title: The Spot Café
hero.tagline: Your Trusted Corporate Catering Partner in Denver's RiNo District
hero.description: Led by owner and Cafe Queen Mandy Smith, The Spot Café is the go-to choice for office catering in the Industry RiNo co-working spaces and surrounding Denver area.

intro.text: For years, we've delivered fresh, flavorful meals that keep teams energized and productive. After serving the National Guard meals for 36 days straight during the Pandemic, we've perfected individually packaged meals and large-scale catering. We specialize in light, nourishing corporate catering designed to fuel your day.
intro.tagline: We KNOW what hits the Spot!

cateringPackagesSection.headline: In-House Catering Packages
cateringPackagesSection.subheadline: Fresh, delicious options for every occasion — from morning meetings to themed celebrations

cateringPackages.name: Breakfast Boards
cateringPackages.description: A medley of continental style breakfast bites — pastries, yogurt, fruit, eggs, muffins, cheese, and more. We can design one specifically for your needs.

cateringPackages.name: Breakfast Burrito Platter
cateringPackages.description: House made breakfast burritos, served with salsa & our famous Sriracha Sour Cream. Available flavors: Bacon, Chorizo, or Veggie. GF and Vegan options available!

cateringPackages.name: Individually Packaged Lunches
cateringPackages.description: From salads and wraps, sandwiches, rice bowls, adult lunchables... you name it. Add drinks or desserts with a mix of cold drinks & cookies!

cateringPackages.name: Buffet Style Lunch
cateringPackages.description: Any of our Cafe Menu options served buffet style — salad bars, build your own rice bowls, build your own wraps, and more.

cateringPackages.name: Themed Meals
cateringPackages.description: We've catered hundreds of corporate events and themed parties. From taco and chili bars, Hawaiian luaus, Oktoberfest, BBQ Picnic... the sky's the limit!

cateringPackages.name: Happy Hour & Grazing
cateringPackages.description: Beautifully crafted charcuterie and grazing boards, perfect for your after-hours meeting or special event.

deliveryOptions.title: Flexible Delivery Options
deliveryOptions.description: However you need it, we'll make it happen. Our focus is on food that's satisfying yet light — keeping everyone full, focused, and ready for whatever the workday brings.
